note: Which tenant and domain each governed project belongs to. Tenant = whose data and authority. Domain = Develop, Business, Personal or Phone. Each project has exactly one of each; a tenant can hold several domains. It lives in the installation rather than in a project, because a project's .projectops/ is writable by that project's own work. See docs/adr/ADR-T1-tenant-boundary.md.

trustBasis: MANUAL_GOVERNANCE_APPROVAL, tamperProof false. Read from committed bytes at the installation's HEAD with replacement objects off, the bytes hashed against their blob, and validated whole before any match: a duplicate or wildcard refuses the entire file. Changing it is the P5 action tenant-registry-change, and every new blob needs a tenant receipt in the installation state. A receipt shows that a person or a process confirmed this blob at a console, nothing more: every commit on this machine carries the name Murad, agent commits included, so nothing here can show the owner did it, and a process that drives a console or writes the receipt and its line directly is not stopped. See ADR-T1 section 3.
